ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between money and romance. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and family. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and money. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and your image. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and your career. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between family and relationships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1811871184000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and routine. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.
